facts.text: Jarrod, I made you a burger. Don't be weird about it. Eat it before it goes cold.
facts.why: The sources show Lily working at the burger shop, but nothing has her making Jarrod a burger. No quote page for the film turned up either. A note in her voice about the shark costume fits the plot.
facts.fix: Jarrod, I'm coming to your party as a shark. Don't be weird about it. It's a good costume.

vibe.verdict: Great poster and a New Zealand menu with Afghan biscuits and L&P, but it skips Jarrod's family and the claymation apples.
missing: Lily losing the video game final on purpose (the party)
Damon's apples that turn up as claymation (the drive)
Jarrod's fight with Eric, who has lost the use of his legs (the finale)
Lily's silly joke at the family dinner that makes everyone laugh (Jarrod's home)
Jarrod's father in the wheelchair on the hill (Lily and Vinny)
The tent in the yard where Jarrod and Lily sleep (Jarrod's family)
